from.place: The open factor in the projection and base-change compatibility: finite constant-coefficient specialization of lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization.

title: Section preserving finite comparisons exist
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and gU,j',j,g a Cartesian square of schemes with open horizontal immersions. Given any SiteSquare and Operations for finiteInput [def-sf-open-normalization-data], there exists a FiniteComparisons record. The four realizations preserve underlying sheaves and constant scalar multiplication; all operation comparisons carry their section, mate, unit and complex-representative pins. The four realizations and both section-normalized direct-image comparisons, both ordinary pullback comparisons, their mate equations, ordinary exactness and invertibility of both specified derived counits on all complexes are proved in Lean. No Assertion or base-change/projection-arrow equality is assumed.

source.place: Tags 00YV, 03D7, 0F6Z; derived tensor comparison via sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YU and 0GL1.

proof.text: Forget commutativity on the locally bijective constant-section map and apply the scalar restriction equivalence from FiniteConstantCoefficientTransport. Its additive inverse equivalence supplies the realization. Whisker its counit by forgetting the A-module structure: this gives the underlying additive sheaf comparison. Linearity of the counit component is exactly the constant-scalar condition, so no arbitrary module data are postulated.

The sheafification units on X and X' are locally injective and locally surjective. Open composition is cocontinuous, so whiskering these units with either open preserves both local properties. Apply the preceding construction four times, including to the literal restricted coefficient sheaves.

For any two realizations whose structural map preserves constant sections, form the underlying direct-image comparison by composing the source underlying isomorphism with the inverse target underlying isomorphism. Linearity for constants follows from scalar preservation and its inverse version. Lift this A-linear map through restrictHomEquivOfIsLocallySurjective; local surjectivity of constants gives full coefficient linearity. The forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, and cancellation of underlying inverses proves the section equation. The ambient coefficient map preserves constants by the sheafification adjunction identity. Its corner map preserves them by naturality of the target unit along t.iso.inv. Apply this construction to g and gU.

Take the inverse mates of the two constructed right squares. inverseMate_isIso_of_equivalences makes them invertible since the two realization functors are equivalences. The general unit_mateEquiv_symm identity is exactly the required ordinary mate equation. Conjugate the exact fixed upperStar through the realization equivalences; the resulting natural isomorphism proves preservation of finite limits and colimits by the specified ordinary ringed pullback. Package these data in FiniteOrdinaryPullPin for g and gU. Exact mapDerivedCategory is a left derived functor with invertible comparison. Uniqueness of left derived functors identifies the specified p.derived with that exact functor and identifies its epsilon with a composite of isomorphisms. Thus epsilon is invertible on all representatives, not just flat ones; retain this as derivedExact.

Apply [lem-sf-finite-operation-comparisons] to the four realizations and the two constructed ordinary pullback pins, which include the section-normalized right squares, their left-adjoint mates, and ordinary exactness. Return the comparison record.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_comparisons_exists (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {U' U X' X : Scheme.{u}} (gU : U' ⟶ U) (j' : U' ⟶ X')
    (j : U ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X) (sq : OpenImmersionSquare gU j' j g)
    {t : SiteSquare (finiteInput A gU j' j g sq)}
    (o : Operations (finiteInput A gU j' j g sq) t) : Nonempty (FiniteComparisons A o)
